description: Enterprise-grade Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase PostgreSQL property management and resort operations platform for five-star island resorts across The Bahamas.

structure..env.example: Configuration template for Supabase credentials, Bahamas VAT TIN, and hotel licensing keys.
structure..gitignore: Standard Next.js, Node, and Supabase git exclusions.
structure.components.json: Shadcn UI component configuration using custom Bahamian luxury palette.
structure.next.config.mjs: Next.js 14 compiler, asset optimization, and security headers.
structure.package.json: Production dependencies (@supabase/ssr, @supabase/supabase-js, framer-motion, lucide-react, zod, tailwindcss, etc.).
structure.README.md: Project setup guide, environment configuration, and architectural references.
structure.tailwind.config.ts: Tailwind configuration defining custom palette: #F8FAF8 canvas, #006B7D reef teal, #E07A5F conch pink, #C5A059 island teak, #1A2E35 charcoal.
structure.tsconfig.json: Strict TypeScript compiler configuration with @/ path aliases.

docs.input_brief.md: Initial executive project brief detailing aesthetic architecture and the 7 resort modules.
docs.DISPATCH_PLAN_AND_TASK_PROMPTS.md: Skill-bound governance and teammate task dispatch plan.
docs.architecture.md: System technical architecture, topology, 25-table Mermaid ER diagram, security model, and component layout.
docs.schema.sql: Production-ready PostgreSQL 15+ DDL covering 25 tables, 100% RLS with InitPlan subqueries, composite indexes, and Cable Beach seed data.
docs.api_contracts.json: Full OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification with RESTful endpoints and RFC 7807 Problem Details schemas.
docs.file_tree.json: Master repository directory and file taxonomy.

supabase.seed.sql: Complete Bahamian resort seed script populating organizations, properties, suites, rates, staff, and folios.

migrations.20261114000001_initial_schema.sql: Initial DDL for the 25 resort tables, custom enums, and foreign key relationships.
migrations.20261114000002_rls_policies.sql: Row Level Security policies with cached InitPlan subqueries (SELECT auth.uid()).
migrations.20261114000003_functions_triggers.sql: Stored procedures for room collision detection, maintenance OOO triage, and Daily Flash Report.

app.globals.css: Tailwind directives, custom scrollbars, and Bahamian color variables.
app.layout.tsx: Root HTML layout injecting modern typography, metadata, and Supabase Auth session provider.
app.page.tsx: Root redirection logic routing users based on user_role (Dashboard, Tape Chart, Housekeeping Mobile, or Login).

login.page.tsx: Luxury resort staff login portal supporting email/password, magic link, and role simulation.

(dashboard).layout.tsx: Main dashboard shell housing the executive sidebar, universal guest search bar, and header.

matrix.page.tsx: Interactive 2D Room Tape Chart (Gantt canvas) plotting physical rooms against dates and operational slots.

bookings.page.tsx: Resort reservation registry with status filters, date range selection, and VIP badges.

[id].page.tsx: Booking detail page featuring check-in/out workflows, digital signature card, and room move trigger.
Master guest folio console displaying itemized charges, Bahamas 10% VAT, service charge, and multi-tender settlement.

rooms.page.tsx: Physical room inventory directory, category attributes, plunge pool flags, and live housekeeping statuses.

rates.page.tsx: Dynamic Caribbean yield management console managing High, Shoulder, and Low seasonal rate calendars.

housekeeping.page.tsx: Housekeeping dispatch dashboard managing departure cleans, daily refreshes, and turndown queues.

maintenance.page.tsx: Engineering work order triage board with P1/P2/P3 severity pills and automated room OOO tracking.

pos.page.tsx: Resort F&B POS terminal with instant room folio charge validation and surname verification.

concierge.page.tsx: Excursion and private yacht charter booking engine with vendor commission splits.

crm.page.tsx: Guest 360 CRM directory with instant (<150ms) search by name, passport, or phone.

[id].page.tsx: Holistic guest profile displaying LTV spend, stay history, dietary preferences, and medical allergy flags.

analytics.page.tsx: Executive RevPAR & Occupancy Cockpit featuring the automated Daily Flash Report and midnight audit metrics.

attendant-portal.page.tsx: Touch-optimized mobile tablet view for room attendants: room status toggles (Dirty -> In-Progress -> Inspected -> Clean).

bookings.route.ts: GET reservations and POST new 15-minute atomic booking hold.

collision-check.route.ts: POST pre-flight room collision evaluation executing in <5ms.

[id].route.ts: GET booking detail, PATCH updates, and DELETE cancellation.

check-in.route.ts: POST express check-in with digital signature and keycard RFID UID.

check-out.route.ts: POST check-out verification and departure housekeeping queue trigger.

room-move.route.ts: POST drag-and-drop room move and baggage transfer notification.

matrix.route.ts: GET 2D tape chart matrix payload for visual Gantt canvas.

[id].route.ts: GET itemized folio charges, balances, and multi-tender status.

transactions.route.ts: POST charge with Bahamas 10% VAT, 10% Service Charge, and 10% Hotel Levy.

settle.route.ts: POST multi-tender settlement with odd-penny preservation algorithm.

statement.route.ts: GET certified tax invoice statement stamped with Bahamas Tax TIN.

tasks.route.ts: GET housekeeping queue and POST task assignments.

[id].route.ts: PATCH status transitions (dirty -> in_progress -> inspected -> clean).

tickets.route.ts: GET work orders and POST issue (P1 urgent triggers room out-of-order).

charge-room.route.ts: POST route F&B check to room folio with mandatory guest surname match.

bookings.route.ts: GET and POST private yacht charters and island excursions.

flash-report.route.ts: GET executive midnight audit flash report (RevPAR, ADR, OCC%).

ui.alert-dialog.tsx: Accessible confirmation dialog for irreversible actions.
ui.badge.tsx: Status badges styled with Palm Green (#2D6A4F), Conch Pink (#E07A5F), and Crimson (#BC4749).
ui.button.tsx: Tactile buttons with smooth elevation and brand color variants.
ui.card.tsx: Clean elevated card containers with Crisp Linen (#FFFFFF) ground.
ui.dialog.tsx: Modal sheets powered by Radix UI and Framer Motion ease curves.
ui.dropdown-menu.tsx: Accessible dropdown actions for tape chart cells and table rows.
ui.input.tsx: Clean inputs with Sandstone borders and Reef Teal focus rings.
ui.table.tsx: High-density data tables with tabular lining figures.
ui.tabs.tsx: Tab navigation with smooth sliding indicators.
ui.tooltip.tsx: Micro-tooltips explaining statutory levies and room tier codes.

layout.header.tsx: Top bar with global CRM guest search, active property switcher, and user profile.
layout.sidebar.tsx: Minimalist vertical navigation with luxury brand typography and module links.
layout.mobile-nav.tsx: Bottom drawer navigation for tablet viewports.

matrix.tape-chart.tsx: Interactive 2D room grid canvas with drag-and-drop room move support.
matrix.room-row.tsx: Individual room track displaying tier icon, room number, and operational status.
matrix.date-header.tsx: Temporal header showing dates, day of week, and daily occupancy percentage.
matrix.booking-block.tsx: Color-coded booking bar rendering guest name, VIP tier, and check-in status.

folios.folio-summary.tsx: Top-level account balance card showing subtotal, taxes, and net due.
folios.transaction-table.tsx: Itemized list of room charges, restaurant bills, and excursions.
folios.multi-tender-modal.tsx: Split-tender payment modal distributing charges across Cash USD/BSD and Cards.
folios.tax-breakdown.tsx: Visual itemization of Bahamas 10% VAT, 10% Service Charge, and 10% Hotel Levy.
folios.invoice-preview.tsx: Printable luxury tax invoice preview with Bahamas VAT TIN.

housekeeping.queue-card.tsx: Room turnover task card with priority flag and estimated cleaning duration.
housekeeping.status-toggle.tsx: One-touch button toggling Dirty -> In-Progress -> Clean.

maintenance.ticket-modal.tsx: Work order creation dialog with category selector and photo uploader.
maintenance.severity-pill.tsx: Visual badge indicating P1 Urgent (OOO trigger), P2 Standard, or P3 Preventative.

pos.outlet-menu.tsx: Visual touch grid of F&B menu items.
pos.cart-panel.tsx: Active order cart with tax and gratuity calculations.
pos.room-verifier.tsx: Modal verifying room number and matching guest surname before charge routing.

analytics.flash-report-card.tsx: Daily Flash Report summary widget with RevPAR, ADR, and Occupancy % gauges.
analytics.revpar-gauge.tsx: Visual circular meter for Revenue Per Available Room vs. budget target.
analytics.adr-chart.tsx: Historical line chart comparing Average Daily Rate across Caribbean seasons.

lib.utils.ts: Tailwind class merging (clsx, twMerge) and date formatting utilities.

supabase.server.ts: Server-side Supabase client for Server Components using cookies.
supabase.middleware.ts: Next.js middleware refreshing session and enforcing RBAC route boundaries.
supabase.rls-guard.ts: Helper verifying user roles (admin, front_desk, concierge, housekeeping, fnb_staff).

math.tax-calculator.ts: Pure functions computing exact Bahamas 10% VAT, 10% Service Charge, and 10% Hotel Levy.
math.odd-penny.ts: Odd-penny preservation algorithm ensuring zero cent leakage across split tenders.
math.revpar-calculator.ts: Formulas computing Occupancy %, ADR, RevPAR, and TRevPAR.
math.currency.ts: Dual-currency utilities maintaining strict 1:1 USD to BSD parity.

validators.booking.schema.ts: Zod schemas for booking creation, collision checks, check-in, and room moves.
validators.folio.schema.ts: Zod schemas for folio charge posting, multi-tender settlement, and refunds.
validators.maintenance.schema.ts: Zod schemas for engineering work order triage and OOO classification.
validators.pos.schema.ts: Zod schemas for F&B outlet orders and room folio charge validations.

types.database.types.ts: Auto-generated TypeScript definitions mirroring the 25-table PostgreSQL schema.
types.models.ts: Domain entity models and joined composite interfaces used in React components.
types.api.ts: Request and response DTO types matching api_contracts.json.
types.enums.ts: TypeScript enums for user roles, room tiers, booking statuses, and task states.

hooks.use-room-matrix.ts: Hook fetching 2D room tape chart data with real-time Supabase subscriptions.
hooks.use-folio.ts: Hook managing active folio transactions, balances, and multi-tender splits.
hooks.use-crm-search.ts: Debounced fast search hook querying guest CRM with <150ms response.
hooks.use-flash-report.ts: Hook fetching executive midnight audit RevPAR and occupancy metrics.
